purpose.zh: 拉伸前腿后侧，为前后劈叉打基础
purpose.en: Stretch the back of the front leg as a first step toward the front splits.

text.zh: 臀部向后坐，前腿伸直，背部拉长
text.en: Sit your hips back, straighten the front leg and keep your back long

text.zh: 后膝跪地，前脚跟着地、脚尖勾起
text.en: Kneel on the back knee with the front heel down and toes up.

text.zh: 双手扶砖，从髋部向前折
text.en: Rest your hands on the blocks and fold forward from your hips.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back to reach forward.

cautions.zh: 跪地膝下垫软垫；拉伸处疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Pad the kneeling knee; ease off if the stretch hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
